query: Last weekend I took my golden retriever to the new dog park near the downtown community center, he had so much fun chasing after frisbees and made friends with a little corgi that kept stealing his favorite chew toy. We ended up staying there for almost three hours, and I had to stop by the pet supply shop on the way home to pick up a new bag of his favorite salmon-flavored treats since we ran out earlier that week. I also tried out that new bubble tea shop right next to the pet store yesterday, their taro milk tea with boba was so creamy, I already plan to go back this weekend to try their matcha variant. Now I need some help with my phone: both of my app permissions have stopped working properly, and I also got a notification saying my data usage has exceeded the monthly limit.
